'''Cularin SpaceNav''' was a company that operated in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==History==
Cularin SpaceNav maintained and analyzed live data about safe shipping routes through the [[Cularin comet cloud]]. Most of the data was supplied by the [[Comet Broom Service]] and was used by shipping.

During the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Garth Ezzar]] had an inaccuracy placed in some of the data supplied to Cularin SpaceNav by Comet Broom. The [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] ''[[Fricasseed Nerf]]'' was supplied with the faulty navigational data by SpaceNav and as a result, collided with a [[Comet/Legends|comet]] fragment.

A short time afterward, the [[heroes of Cularin]] prevented a comet from crashing into the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Almas]]. A conference was held in the [[Forard]] [[Civic Center (Forard)|Civic Center]] to discuss the incident and a delegation from Cularin SpaceNav attended the meeting.
